events.title: Update 0.7.0.46 - Gathering Professions & Resource Sense
events.summary: Gathering ProfessionsFour new professions. Every character now has Woodcutting, Mining, Herbalism and Harvesting, each going from level 0 to 10. Every successful swing at a tree, rock, herb or crop earns experience in the matching profession, and a chat message tells you when you level up. Tools follow your gathering level. events.title: Update 0.7.0.35 - Rest, User Guide & Action Bar Key Icons
events.summary: Take a Rest You can now sit down and recover. Find the new Rest action in the Skills window's Actions tab, or drag it onto your action bar. Faster regeneration. While seated, your Health, Mana and Stamina come back noticeably faster. Everyone sees it. Players around you see you sit down, and anyone who arrives later sees you already seated. Resting has a cost. You can't move or use skills while seated, but potions and other consumables still work. Press Rest again to stand up. Danger gets you up

events.title: Update 0.7.0.26 - A Living Sky: Smooth Day, Night and Sunsets
events.summary: A Living Sky The day and night cycle has been rebuilt from the ground up. It used to switch between a fixed "day" look and a fixed "night" look, so the world went dark all at once at 21:00 and lit up all at once at 05:00. That is gone. The sun and moon now travel across the sky. They follow a continuous path instead of snapping between states, and the light, fog, clouds and sky colours blend gradually through dusk and dawn. events.summary: Daily Quests and Zone Bosses Twenty-five repeatable daily quests. events.title: Update 0.6.9.151 - Combat Rebalance, Fast Travel Overhaul & Loading Screens
events.summary: Combat Rebalance Armour keeps working, all the way up. Defense used to hit an invisible ceiling - past roughly 1.5x an attacker's Attack Power every extra point of armour did nothing, because at least 25% of every attack always got through. Defense is now subtracted from incoming damage in full, so tank builds, shields and heavy armour keep scaling. events.title: Update 0.6.9.132 - Teleport Crystals, Cave Spiders & Bouncy Mushrooms
events.summary: Teleport Crystals Fares are now shown as real items. Talking to a teleport crystal used to spell the price out in words. Each destination now shows the item's icon, its name, and an owned/required count that turns green or red depending on whether you can afford it. Hover a fare row for the full item tooltip. events.title: Update 0.6.9.116 - Quest Markers, Records Tab, Timed Quests & Walking
events.summary: Quests Now Point the Way Quest givers advertise themselves. An exclamation mark floats above any NPC offering a quest you are eligible to take, and a second marker appears above the character who can close out the objective you are working on right now. The markers are personal to your own quest log - your level, your prerequisites, what you have already taken and what you have already finished. Markers on the map and minimap. events.title: Update 0.6.9.94 - Karma & Outlaws, Quest Overhaul, Combat Fixes
events.summary: This is the largest update the playtest has had so far. Murder now carries a real price, quests have been rebuilt from the ground up with a proper journal and an on-screen tracker, and a set of long-standing combat bugs have been put down. Karma and the Outlaw System Killing other players is now a decision with consequences that follow you around. Murder earns you Karma. events.title: Update 0.6.9.58 - Membership Store Overhaul
events.summary: Membership Store Products finally say what they are. "VIP Silver - 7 days" and "VIP Silver - 30 days" are now distinguishable at a glance, instead of both simply reading "Silver". Your tier and expiry are on screen. The store now shows the membership you currently hold and the exact date it runs out, right at the top. A "+" marks purchases that extend your time. events.title: Update 0.6.9.55 - Crafting Professions, Server Queue & VIP Tiers
events.summary: This is a big one. Crafting has been rebuilt around a full Professions system, full servers now hand you a queue instead of a closed door, and a long list of fixes lands alongside them. Details below. Crafting Professions Crafting is no longer a flat menu you click through. It is now driven by five professions - Blacksmith, Alchemist, Chef, Jeweller and Tailor - that you level independently, and every part of the crafting experience has been rewritten around them. events.title: Update 0.6.9.35 - Restart-Proof Progress & Tier 0 Armor Fixes
events.summary: Your Progress Survives Server Restarts Nothing is lost when a server goes down. Until now, a restart could roll your character back by up to five minutes. Your progress was only written to the database on a timer or when you logged out cleanly, so a restart in between threw away whatever you had done since - items picked up or crafted, experience earned, quest steps completed, gear equipped, and even where you were standing. events.title: Update 0.6.9.26 - Containers Count, Safer Item Drops
events.summary: Containers Now Pull Their Weight Loot files itself away. If you are carrying a container that accepts an item, anything the world hands you goes straight into it. Right now that means recipes and your Recipe Book, so picking one up no longer means opening your bag and dragging it across. It covers every source of loot. events.title: Update 0.6.9.19 - Party Colours, Trade Tooltips & Spell Impacts
events.summary: Parties Spot your party at a glance. Every player in your party now shows their overhead name in the same green used by party chat, while everyone else stays white. It is personal to you: another party's members are green to each other, never to you. Names change colour the moment someone joins, leaves or the party disbands, with no reloading. events.summary: A big one. The basic attack has been rebuilt from the ground up with all-new effects, a new Fire Bolt spell joins the game, the Class Master is finally open for business, and every monster in the world has been rebalanced onto a single difficulty curve. The Basic Attack, Rebuilt Your bread-and-butter attack was rebuilt from scratch — new ability, new effects, new audio. The old attack has been retired entirely. All-new impact effects. events.title: Update 0.6.8.127 - Radius Pickup, Gathering Polish & Smoother Looting
events.summary: Radius Pickup Grab everything at once. Press the interact key while you are not aiming at anything interactable and your character sweeps up every eligible drop around you, closest first. Aiming directly at a single drop still works exactly as before, and aiming always takes priority - if you are looking at a gathering node, an NPC, a craft station or a specific item, you interact with that instead. events.title: Update 0.6.8.111 - Eleven Languages, Scaling Skills & Combat Fixes
events.summary: Eleven Languages Eight new languages are live. Deutsch, Francais, Italiano, Polski, Portugues (Brasil), Korean, Japanese and Simplified Chinese join English, Espanol and Russian. Open Settings, then System, and pick your language from the dropdown - the game switches immediately and remembers your choice next time you play. The whole game is translated now, not just the menus. Item names, crafting recipes, ingredient names, skill descriptions, tooltips, and party, trade, chat and map messages us

events.title: Update 0.6.8.50 - Arrows, Aiming Fix & the Cave Spider
events.summary: Arrows and Ammunition Wooden Arrows are here. Craft them from the smithing recipe, stack them up to 999 per bag slot, and equip the whole quiver into your off-hand alongside a bow. They have their own icon and world model. Cheap Shot now spends arrows. Every shot costs one arrow, and firing on an empty quiver tells you "You have no arrows." instead of loosing a phantom shot. Arrows are a real ammunition type. They no longer eat a bag slot each, they swap cleanly with shields in both directions,

events.title: Update 0.6.8.93 - Level Cap 100, XP Rework & Monsters Fight Back
events.summary: Level Cap Raised to 100 The ceiling is now level 100. Levels 1 through 50 are completely unchanged - your character keeps its exact level and experience, nothing was rescaled or reset. Beyond 50 the curve continues along the progression it always followed internally, so the climb past the old wall should feel like a natural continuation. Characters sitting at the old cap simply resume earning toward 51. Experience totals are now exact. Experience is stored as a whole number rather than a decimal

events.title: Update 0.6.8.36 - Overhead Chat Bubbles & Speed-Hack Blocking
events.summary: Overhead Chat Bubbles Chat now happens in the world, not just the chat box. When a nearby player sends a message on a public channel - Global, Region, Zone, Proximity or Party - it appears as a speech bubble above their character, coloured to match the channel it was sent on. Bubbles fade after a few seconds and only show for players close enough to see them. You can see when someone nearby is typing. A neutral indicator appears above a player who is composing a message. events.title: Update 0.6.8.29 - Fairer Death Penalty & Speed-Hack Blocking
events.summary: Death XP Penalty Rebuilt The same cost at every level. Dying now costs 20% of your current level's bar - the same visible amount at level 5 as at level 50. The old penalty took a fifth of your total lifetime experience, which sounds fixed but was not: because each level costs far more than the last, that same fifth bought progressively more of your progress bar the higher you climbed. Around level 10 it crossed half a level, by level 19 it was a full level, and past level 40 it was well over two
